diff --git a/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..26c43997d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,311 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         *bool
+	headers         []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	cookies         []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	queryParameters []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	filterState     []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	sourceIp        *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return reflect.DeepEqual(c, otherCH)
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	if c.disable != nil && *c.disable {
+		if len(c.headers) > 0 || len(c.cookies) > 0 || len(c.queryParameters) > 0 || len(c.filterState) > 0 || c.sourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in header rewrite: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, cookie := range c.cookies {
+		if cookie.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseTTL(cookie.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+func parseTTL(ttlStr string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		return time.Duration(sec) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return time.ParseDuration(ttlStr)
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		d := true
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: &d,
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+
+	// Deduplicate headers (case-insensitive key, preserving first occurrence casing)
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if !seenHeaders[key] {
+			seenHeaders[key] = true
+			ir.headers = append(ir.headers, h)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate cookies (by name)
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if !seenCookies[c.Name] {
+			seenCookies[c.Name] = true
+			ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, c)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate queryParameters (by name)
+	seenQP := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if !seenQP[qp.Name] {
+			seenQP[qp.Name] = true
+			ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, qp)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate filterState (by key)
+	seenFS := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+		if !seenFS[fs.Key] {
+			seenFS[fs.Key] = true
+			ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, fs)
+		}
+	}
+
+	ir.sourceIp = ch.SourceIP
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+}
+
+func buildEnvoyHashPolicies(ch *consistentHashIR) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if ch == nil || (ch.disable != nil && *ch.disable) {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	hasHeaders := len(ch.headers) > 0
+	hasCookies := len(ch.cookies) > 0
+	hasQueryParams := len(ch.queryParameters) > 0
+	hasFilterState := len(ch.filterState) > 0
+	hasSourceIP := ch.sourceIp != nil
+
+	if !hasHeaders && !hasCookies && !hasQueryParams && !hasFilterState && !hasSourceIP {
+		// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	var res []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range ch.headers {
+		p := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			p.GetHeader().RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		if h.Terminal != nil {
+			p.Terminal = *h.Terminal
+		}
+		res = append(res, p)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, c := range ch.cookies {
+		p := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+					Name: c.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if c.Path != "" {
+			p.GetCookie().Path = c.Path
+		}
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			if dur, err := parseTTL(c.TTL); err == nil {
+				p.GetCookie().Ttl = durationpb.New(dur)
+			}
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			p.GetCookie().Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		if c.Terminal != nil {
+			p.Terminal = *c.Terminal
+		}
+		res = append(res, p)
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, qp := range ch.queryParameters {
+		p := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if qp.Terminal != nil {
+			p.Terminal = *qp.Terminal
+		}
+		res = append(res, p)
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, fs := range ch.filterState {
+		p := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if fs.Terminal != nil {
+			p.Terminal = *fs.Terminal
+		}
+		res = append(res, p)
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIP
+	if ch.sourceIp != nil {
+		p := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if ch.sourceIp.Terminal != nil {
+			p.Terminal = *ch.sourceIp.Terminal
+		}
+		res = append(res, p)
+	}
+
+	return res
+}
+
+func deepCopyConsistentHash(src *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if src == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	dst := &consistentHashIR{}
+	if src.disable != nil {
+		d := *src.disable
+		dst.disable = &d
+	}
+	if len(src.headers) > 0 {
+		dst.headers = make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, len(src.headers))
+		copy(dst.headers, src.headers)
+	}
+	if len(src.cookies) > 0 {
+		dst.cookies = make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie, len(src.cookies))
+		for i, c := range src.cookies {
+			dstCookie := c
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				dstCookie.Attributes = make([]kgateway.CookieAttribute, len(c.Attributes))
+				copy(dstCookie.Attributes, c.Attributes)
+			}
+			dst.cookies[i] = dstCookie
+		}
+	}
+	if len(src.queryParameters) > 0 {
+		dst.queryParameters = make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter, len(src.queryParameters))
+		copy(dst.queryParameters, src.queryParameters)
+	}
+	if len(src.filterState) > 0 {
+		dst.filterState = make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, len(src.filterState))
+		copy(dst.filterState, src.filterState)
+	}
+	if src.sourceIp != nil {
+		dst.sourceIp = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{}
+		if src.sourceIp.Terminal != nil {
+			t := *src.sourceIp.Terminal
+			dst.sourceIp.Terminal = &t
+		}
+	}
+	return dst
+}

+		// sourceIp on p1 was unset (nil), so it remains unset!

+		policies := buildEnvoyHashPolicies(p1.spec.consistentHash)

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p2 == nil || p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = deepCopyConsistentHash(p2.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	ch1 := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	ch2 := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if ch1.disable != nil && *ch1.disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ch2.disable != nil && *ch2.disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	appended := false
+
+	// Deduplicate headers
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, h := range ch1.headers {
+		seenHeaders[strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)] = true
+	}
+	for _, h := range ch2.headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if !seenHeaders[key] {
+			seenHeaders[key] = true
+			ch1.headers = append(ch1.headers, h)
+			appended = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate cookies
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, c := range ch1.cookies {
+		seenCookies[c.Name] = true
+	}
+	for _, c := range ch2.cookies {
+		if !seenCookies[c.Name] {
+			seenCookies[c.Name] = true
+			ch1.cookies = append(ch1.cookies, c)
+			appended = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate queryParameters
+	seenQP := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, qp := range ch1.queryParameters {
+		seenQP[qp.Name] = true
+	}
+	for _, qp := range ch2.queryParameters {
+		if !seenQP[qp.Name] {
+			seenQP[qp.Name] = true
+			ch1.queryParameters = append(ch1.queryParameters, qp)
+			appended = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate filterState
+	seenFS := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, fs := range ch1.filterState {
+		seenFS[fs.Key] = true
+	}
+	for _, fs := range ch2.filterState {
+		if !seenFS[fs.Key] {
+			seenFS[fs.Key] = true
+			ch1.filterState = append(ch1.filterState, fs)
+			appended = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// sourceIp scalar retains higher-priority policy's value (ch1.sourceIp) even when unset.
+
+	if appended {
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+	}
+}
